Each flag was checked against the run's own tool output. call: false_flag = the flagged claim is supported, or isn't the model's claim; audit_miss = a real slip the audit didn't label. cause: pairing = a value checked against the wrong time, row, column, or source; range-read = a listed or example value read as a range claim; partial-row = the last, still-filling row counted as unread; scope = the claim's own scope ignored; context = a number read out of its phrase; not-a-claim = leaked markup or the guard's halt text.
